reasoning: This is a strong, near-production-ready PRD that clears a high bar on all four dimensions. Framing is crisp with quantified success metrics and an honest top-risk callout. Story coverage is comprehensive across the full user journey with well-formed Given/When/Then acceptance criteria. Risk articulation is unusually thorough, covering regulatory, latency, privacy, bias, scraping, and baseline-validity risks with concrete mitigations. Requirements are EARS-formatted and largely measurable, with the notable gaps being the undefined confidence-score threshold that drives a core P0 behavior (R-11/AC-11) and the absence of testable requirements for the safety deny-list and PHI filter, which are the highest-severity risks in the document. Those two gaps should be closed before engineering handoff—specifically, the confidence threshold needs a numeric value or a defined calibration process, and the compliance/safety layer needs at least one acceptance criterion covering what the system does when a goal or AI output is flagged. Open questions are well-scoped and appropriately flagged as blockers or decisions needed pre-launch.
